name: Futu
description: Futu lets agents read stock quotes, market data, and portfolio positions in the signed-in Futu account. Each user signs in to their own Futu account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is the latest quote and day range for Tencent (00700)?
Summarize my current positions and their profit and loss.
Compare the 30-day performance of the stocks in my watchlist.

apps.name: Futu
apps.description: Quotes, market data, and portfolio access, over Futu's MCP server with browser sign-in.
